AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Moist Bed Garden and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Controlling Soil Erosion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Water: seedbed pits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
